markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (53%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Unreliable input (32% reliability) [F6] cannot separate Benign from InSitu (46%) [F1]; defer frozen margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 53%, InSitu 46%, Invasive 1% | Nearly tied top classes |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot separate at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 32% reliability (flagged), 84% OOD | Suspect input, atypical image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 80% Benign (4/5; InSitu 89%) [F5] | Mostly Benign, close InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 1, 9) · context · Strongest score (-0.77), descriptive (8/20 AI check) [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 4, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score +0.42, fails AI check (3/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Weak concept (+0.40), 0/20 AI check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 4, 5) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.32, 12/20 AI check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.011, CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unfaithful (deletion CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); leans on Unreliable necrosis and mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 8 (85%), 9 (74%), 4 (61%) harbor in situ or invasive carcinoma.
- Low-reliability section (AUROC 0.70) masks InSitu features matching BACH_0057 (89% similarity, pleomorphism/mitoses).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 4**: Inspect top-risk tiles (85%, 74%, 61%) for atypia or invasion.
2. **Regions 1, 3, 5**: Check pleomorphism and ducts; consider drafted deeper levels and recut.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Defer superior, inferior, medial margins (100%) to permanent sections.
